picks.headline: Adobe crams multiple AI tools into its experimental Project Indigo camera app
picks.excerpt: Adobe's Project Indigo experimental camera app adds AI Playground, bringing generative editing, object edits, style transforms and photo guidance to mobile photographers, powered by Google's Nano Banana model.
picks.rationale: High actionability: Adobe pushes generative editing, object edits and style transforms into a live mobile camera app -- a concrete shift in how designers and photographers capture and edit on the go.

picks.headline: Samsung's new AI-powered Health Assistant helps you make sense of your health data
picks.excerpt: Samsung launched Health Assistant, an AI chatbot inside Samsung Health that interprets your wellness data and offers personalized, physician-validated lifestyle recommendations across its wearable ecosystem.
picks.rationale: A distinct Samsung Health software feature -- an AI chatbot that turns raw wellness data into physician-validated guidance, showing how conversational AI is being layered onto everyday health tools.

picks.headline: Friend is back with a new AI pendant -- now with a speaker and a subscription
picks.excerpt: Friend relaunches its always-listening AI companion pendant as Friend 2.0 for $249, now with a built-in speaker for voice replies and a $10/month subscription for memory beyond 30 days.
picks.rationale: Fresh, credible marker of where wearable AI hardware is heading: the Friend 2.0 relaunch adds voice replies and a memory subscription, distinct from the already-published Looki pendant.
